lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hey Priya, Daniela here. How's your Tuesday going?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi, yes, perfect timing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Here's what I had in mind for today, but tell me if you'd rather focus on something else.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How's your body feeling this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not bad. Sleeping better.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That's great to hear.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, not really. I told my family I'm done eating at 8.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sometimes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Uh, sometimes. I'll set an alarm on my phone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What could you try instead?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know, honestly.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Can I share an idea?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Finishing dinner a little earlier, like by 7, makes the 13 hours a lot easier.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're starting to see that small changes add up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is coffee with milk the first thing you have?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you eat breakfast every day?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. If I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're really honest with yourself, and that helps.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So what would you like your goal to be for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe finish eating by 7 on 4 nights?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Can we do a little later? I have an appointment.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Take care, Priya. You're doing great.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: God bless you.

tags.note: Offers agenda with choice to redirect
Commits to a stopping time with family
Names a planning strategy that works
Follow-up logistics; midweek text and two-week call
Requests a later time; not addressed

flags.reason: Participant committed to stopping eating at 8 with family; coach moved to a closed question without reflecting or strengthening it.
Participant asked to move the call later due to an appointment; coach ignored it and closed the call, and the follow-up timing (midweek text, two-week call) was not confirmed.

score.summary: Coach used many closed questions and moved past several change statements without reflecting them, though a goal was eventually set in the participant's own words. The participant's scheduling request at line 36 went unaddressed, and the call closed without confirming the follow-up timing.
strengths: Offered the agenda with a choice to redirect (line 3) and asked permission before advice (line 16).
Set a concrete goal in the participant's own words and affirmed her honesty and planning (lines 28, 33-34).
coaching_tips: Reflect the commitment in line 9 (e.g., 'You've decided to finish eating by 8 and told your family') before asking the next question.
Replace closed questions like lines 8, 10, 12 and 22 with open ones such as 'What makes it hard to stop at 8?' to draw out more change talk.
Address the appointment request in line 36 by rescheduling the call or confirming the next contact time before ending.
